IC1: - Diagnosis of periodontitis (stages III or IV) that may require periodontal surgery
IC2: - Have at least 10 teeth in function, excluding third molars.
IC3: - Present locations with probing depth (PS)> 6 mm in at least 30% of the teeth.
IC4: - Present radiographic evidence of moderate-severe bone loss in at least 30% of the dentition.
IC5: - Detection of P. gingivalis in subgingival samples taken at the screening [AND] visit as well as in the post-scaling [OR] and root planning visit and processed by culture.
